perspective:
From Sara Manuelito’s available perspective:

- Sara is a Speech-Language Pathologist and longtime colleague/close friend of Shirley Whiteplume, a nurse, at the community health center.
- A mutual patient died. Sara attended the funeral and saw Shirley looking somber; Sara suspected Shirley was deeply affected and had cared for him.
- At the funeral, Sara told Shirley she knew it was hard and had seen how much Shirley cared. Shirley replied it had been tough and she kept thinking whether more could have been done. Sara said they did everything they could and should remember the good care and joy they brought. Shirley said Sara was right but it was hard to let go.
- During a coffee break, Sara brought up their treatment decisions and said she sensed Shirley felt burdened. Shirley said she felt responsible and wondered if pushing for a different approach could have helped. Sara said they made the best decisions with the information they had and that Shirley should not carry it alone. Shirley appreciated it but said it was hard to accept.
- In their office, after observing Shirley’s reserved behavior and minimal emotional expression, Sara told her she noticed she was holding back feelings and that it was okay to be open. Shirley said she was not sure she could and did not want to seem unprofessional or weak. Sara said showing emotions does not make her weak and is healthy among friends. Shirley said maybe Sara was right and she would try.
- Later, Sara felt her previous confrontation might have been too harsh. She apologized if she came on too strong. Shirley said it was a bit much but she knew Sara meant well and appreciated the apology. Sara said she understood and was there for Shirley however needed. Shirley thanked her and said continuing to talk helps.
- After some time, Sara noticed Shirley seemed improved. Sara asked how she was feeling. Shirley said she felt better, thanks to their talks and Sara’s support. Sara offered to spend more time together outside work. Shirley said she would like that and suggested planning something for the weekend. Sara felt hopeful and supported further.
